IdentityA leader in armour and a strong front-line fighter who names one foe, holds it with a Challenge and turns a band of allies into a disciplined line.

Level by Level at a Glance

What you gain and when. Full details are under Class Abilities.

Class Abilities

1st Level

Birthright Mount

  • Effect: In addition to starting money, knights begin play with a fully outfitted riding horse (saddle, blankets, saddlebags, bit and bridle, harness, horseshoes, 1 meal) that is a light warhorse (15 HP, Hit Dice 2d10+4; see Mounts & Beasts of Burden in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue).

Horsemanship (Dexterity)

  • Effect: Trained in all aspects of mounted combat with no check required: saddle, mount, ride, dismount; control the mount in combat; guide with the knees; stay in the saddle when the mount rears or bolts; assess horse quality.
  • Your mount needs no check to charge, leap or fall softly: it does what you tell it
  • If your mount can attack (see Mounted Combat in The Arneyan Codex), it attacks as part of your action, with Advantage, and you have Advantage on your first melee attack each round from the saddle
  • Mounted manoeuvres: from the saddle you have three, always on:
    • Mounted Charge: a charge from the saddle uses your mount's movement (see Mounted Combat in The Arneyan Codex).
    • On a hit, a target no larger than your mount makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.
    • A lance still doubles its damage dice.
    • Ride-By: after you attack from the saddle, your mount's remaining movement doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity from the creature you attacked.
    • Overrun: once per round, in place of one of your attacks, your mount moves through a smaller creature's space; that creature makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.

Martial Bearing

  • Effect: Your melee weapon hits deal +1 damage. Always on. Improves to +2 at 6th level, +3 at 9th, +4 at 12th, +5 at 15th, +6 at 18th, +7 at 21st and +8 at 24th.

Command (Charisma)

  • Effect: Uses per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 2), +1 more at 6th level and again at 12th.
  • Spend a use as part of your action, once per round, to give a Command to allies within 30ft who can see or hear you; it lasts for the encounter.
  • Only one Command is active at a time: a new one ends the last.
  • Inspire (the default Command): allies have Advantage on saves against fear, and one hit of each ally's choice each round on your Challenged foe deals an extra weapon damage die. Giving Inspire also ends Frightened on allies who can hear you.
  • 19th level: your Command range doubles to 60ft, and allies feel your Commands even when they can't see or hear you

2nd Level

Challenge

  • Effect: Once per encounter, as part of an attack, name one foe within 30ft that can hear you.
  • It makes a Will save against your Class Save DC, or has Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you for the encounter.
  • Whether or not it saves, you have Advantage on your first attack roll each round against it for the encounter.
  • Your first attack in each encounter Challenges its target automatically, unless you choose another foe.

3rd Level

Command: Expert in Arms

  • Effect: A new Command option: allies within 30ft have Advantage on manoeuvre contests and on checks to resist being Grappled, Tripped or Disarmed.

4th Level

Knight's Riposte

  • Effect: Once per round, out of turn, when your Challenged foe attacks an ally within your reach, you may make one melee attack against it.

5th Level

Challenger's Blow

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex). No Disadvantage against the creature you've Challenged; on a hit, it has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.

6th Level

Honour Attack

  • Effect: Add your Charisma modifier to your first attack roll each round against your Challenged foe. Always on.
  • 17th level: once per encounter, your first hit on your Challenged foe doubles the weapon's damage dice (flat modifiers are not doubled). It never stacks with another doubling, such as a lance's charge: use one.

7th Level

Command: Demoralise

  • Effect: A new Command option: enemies within 30ft who can see you make a Will save against your Class Save DC or are Frightened of you for as long as the Command lasts.
  • Shaking it off: a Frightened enemy saves again at the end of each of its turns. Once it saves, it isn't Frightened again until you Demoralise anew, which needs a fresh save (no immunity).

8th Level

Battlefield Dominance

  • Effect: Keep two different Commands active at once.

9th Level

Command: Embolden

  • Effect: A new Command option: companions and followers within 30ft have Advantage on Will saves.

11th Level

Champion's Reckoning

  • Effect: A foe that fails its save against your Challenge is also Cowed: while it can see you, its speed is halved when it moves towards you or away from you.
  • A creature immune to fear is immune to this effect

13th Level

Undying Reputation

  • Effect: The first time each encounter you drop below half HP in view of at least one ally or enemy, you gain temporary HP equal to your Knight level + your Charisma modifier.
  • 24th level: the temporary HP equals twice your Knight level + your Charisma modifier, and you have Advantage on your first attack roll each round until the encounter ends

15th Level

  • Charisma Bonus: permanent +1 Charisma. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).

19th Level

Battle Lord

  • Effect: Allies who can see you add your Charisma modifier to the damage of one hit each round. Leading troops in a mass battle: see Keeps & Kingdoms.

20th Level

Renown: Castle

  • Effect: You may found a castle (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 2d10 followers (Level 0) and one 1st-level Knight come to your banner, and you choose who stays.
  • Your scutage pays them: 3 gp a month for a follower, 4 gp a month per Level for a Knight.
  • While you hold it, a follower who has served a year may be knighted, as under Conversion to Knighthood.

21st Level

Conversion to Knighthood

  • Effect: You may knight a follower or other NPC who has earned it; Keeps & Kingdoms gives the rules for knighted followers.

24th Level

Path of Greatness

  • Effect: Choose to become legendary. The knight may never back down from a fight or challenge. When fighting stronger opponents, have Advantage on your first attack roll each round and gain the Level difference as a bonus to damage.
  • Friends and allies who can see the knight have Advantage on morale checks while the knight remains on the field
  • Cowardice, retreating or fleeing certain death voids the Path for good: the knight loses it and every Knight ability from 20th level up, keeping HP and BtH

Paths: Knightly Orders

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Knight folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Path at character creation: the kind of knight you are.

  • Your Path gives two features at 1st level and one more at 5th and at 10th.
  • Knights take no kit.
  • The orders and places a Path names are examples, not the only ones: a Path suits any knight of that kind.
